official_definition: (Opposing Start Step) The opponent chooses a Spirit they control and compares BP with this Spirit. Destroy the Spirit(s) with equal or lower BP. When only the opposing Spirit is destroyed, activate the following effect: XXXXXXX

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Showdown] or [Showdown: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Showdown]", "give [Showdown]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
